comparison.objective: Use a scoop to deliver uncontaminated ice into a bowl; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Ice task tests tool pickup, scooping, containment, pouring/release, and hygiene-aware contact sequencing; candidate tests hex-key engagement, collar rotation, locking torque, and iterative response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: At least one clean cube must be scoop-delivered and settle within the bowl while avoiding contamination, fish-source ice, hand delivery, and invalid contact reporting; candidate requires two safe impact cycles and drift control.
comparison.reason: Tool use alone is not sufficient overlap; hygienic bulk transfer tests a different ability. Missing rubric details: exact cavity/contact thresholds are deferred to the README rather than reproduced in the indexed spec.
